caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a bonnet occupying the left-center portion of the composition. The bonnet is rendered in a monochromatic green color, showing elaborate, concentric, horizontal bands or pleats around the crown, a large bow at the side, and ribbon ties hanging down. The fabric is gathered and ruched around the back of the bonnet, and the ribbons appear to be made of the same material as the main body. The background is plain and neutral, with the surface texture of the paper visible. In the upper right section of the drawing, there is a simpler pencil outline sketch of the same bonnet seen from the front, showing the shape, undetailed face area, and some of the ruffled detail around the brim. The overall composition leaves much of the background empty, focusing attention on the two bonnet illustrations.
title: Calash
